dialogues.jp: 「ぐふぅっ……」
dialogues.en: I had way over the lethal dosage of her food.
dialogues.text: I had way over the lethal dosage of her food.

dialogues.jp: 苦しい……。
dialogues.en:
I won't die from eating it regularly. I'll just continue to
struggle on......
dialogues.text:
I won't die from eating it regularly. I'll just continue to
struggle on......

dialogues.jp:
音夢の作った晩飯を食べた後、自室に戻ってベッ
ドに沈み込む。
dialogues.en: "......I have to go through this for 4 more days......?"
dialogues.text: "......I have to go through this for 4 more days......?"

dialogues.jp: この毒物の欠点は、致死量が多いことだろう。
dialogues.en: This is a living hell.
dialogues.text: This is a living hell.

dialogues.jp:
普通に食べただけでは死ねない。ただ苦しみを
味わうのみ……。
「……こんなことがあと４日も続くとは」
dialogues.en: I think I'm going to have a nightmare......
dialogues.text: I think I'm going to have a nightmare......

dialogues.jp: まさに生き地獄。
dialogues.en: (But I've been having a hard time dreaming lately.)
dialogues.text: (But I've been having a hard time dreaming lately.)

dialogues.en:
It doesn't mean that I've had bad dreams, but I can't dream
as clearly as before.
dialogues.text:
It doesn't mean that I've had bad dreams, but I can't dream
as clearly as before.

dialogues.jp: 夢でも、うなされそう……。
dialogues.en: For most of the time, I don't even dream at all.
dialogues.text: For most of the time, I don't even dream at all.

dialogues.jp: （でも、そういや最近、夢見が悪いんだよな）
dialogues.en: "I wonder what's going on......"
dialogues.text: "I wonder what's going on......"

dialogues.jp:
この場合は“嫌な夢を見る”ではなくて“夢が
見にくい“ってことだけど。
dialogues.en: "Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: "Knock, knock......

dialogues.jp:
しかも見せられる夢の数自体、ほとんど無いに
等しい。
dialogues.en: "May I come in, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "May I come in, niisan?"

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: "You may for a moment."
dialogues.text: "You may for a moment."

dialogues.jp: カチャ――
dialogues.en: Click......
dialogues.text: Click......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ」
dialogues.en: "What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: "What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.jp: 以前同様、パジャマ姿で入ってくる。
dialogues.en: She came into my room in her pajamas.
dialogues.text: She came into my room in her pajamas.

dialogues.jp: 「なに遠慮してんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you being so hesitant?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you being so hesitant?"

dialogues.jp: ベッドの上で上半身を起こし、音夢を迎える。
dialogues.en: I asked her while I lifted my body up from the bed.
dialogues.text: I asked her while I lifted my body up from the bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、なんか久しぶりだったから……」
dialogues.en: "Well, because it's been a while......"
dialogues.text: "Well, because it's been a while......"

dialogues.jp: パジャマの｛すそ／裾｝をいじりながら、音夢が答える。
dialogues.en:
Nemu answered while she played with the skirt of her
pajamas. I can almost see inside......
dialogues.text:
Nemu answered while she played with the skirt of her
pajamas. I can almost see inside......

dialogues.jp:
「自分の家で遠慮してどうすんだって。で、何
　の用だ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't be hesitant in your own home. So what do you want?"
dialogues.text: "Don't be hesitant in your own home. So what do you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん……ちょっと挨拶だけ」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I just came here to say hi."
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I just came here to say hi."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おやすみなさい、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Good night, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Good night, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
それだけ言うと、鈴を鳴らして、部屋から出て
いく。
dialogues.en: She spoke and left the room with the noise of a bell.
dialogues.text: She spoke and left the room with the noise of a bell.

dialogues.jp: 「おやすみ」
dialogues.en: "Goodnight."
dialogues.text: "Goodnight."

dialogues.jp: ポスッと枕に頭をのせ、｛まぶた／瞼｝を閉じる。
dialogues.en: I laid my head on the pillow and closed my eyes.
dialogues.text: I laid my head on the pillow and closed my eyes.

dialogues.jp: しばらくは音夢に起こしてもらおう……。
dialogues.en: I'll have her wake me up in the mornings for a while......
dialogues.text: I'll have her wake me up in the mornings for a while......

dialogues.jp: ◆お休みの挨拶◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢の作った料理を食べて、死に切れずにベッ
ドに横になっていると、部屋に音夢が現れた。
dialogues.en: I'm struggling......
dialogues.text: I'm struggling......

dialogues.jp:
音夢は、ただお休みと言うためだけに来たらし
い。相変わらずなやつだ。俺もおやすみと言い
返した。
dialogues.en:
After I had Nemu's home cooked meal, I went back to my room
and got into bed.
dialogues.text:
After I had Nemu's home cooked meal, I went back to my room
and got into bed.
